sources.title: Training the GIN Model | LirongWu/MAPE-PPI | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Training the GIN model is a critical step in the MAPE-PPI system that enables accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions. The process leverages pretrained protein embeddings from the VAE model and employs standard deep learning practices like batch processing, learning rate scheduling, and early stopping to achieve optimal performance.
